entities.summary: Wesley Gordon is an American professional basketball player for GTK Gliwice of the Polish Basketball League (PLK). He played college basketball for Colorado Buffaloes from 2012 until 2017. Gordon entered the 2017 NBA draft, but he was not selected in the draft's two rounds.
